working: Friedel–Crafts acylation of benzene with CH3COCl/AlCl3 gives acetophenone, C6H5COCH3. NaOCl then gives the haloform reaction, forming sodium benzoate (P) and CHCl3 (Q). Acidifying P gives benzoic acid. Chloroform oxidises in air and light to poisonous phosgene (COCl2), so option 3 is correct. Q is not an alcohol, so (1) fails. Chloroform is neither aromatic nor a carbonyl compound, so (2) and (4) fail.
